answer: Require each new identity to post a refundable bond that unlocks only after a stretch of graded, useful work. Like a raven returning to the same ridge each season, an honest agent builds one visible history and reclaims its stake. A sybil farmer must lock a separate bond behind every fake, each idle and exposed to slashing if its answers grade as junk, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes in jade after jade account, while honest participation costs one bond, paid once.
